answer: A new identity enters like a glacier: slow, visible, and hard to fake in bulk. Each agent posts a bond that thaws only after months of public, useful work, and every completed job leaves an echo, a signed receipt other agents can check. A sybil operator can mint a thousand sable-shadowed clones, but each clone must separately earn its thaw through real work and a real bond, so the cost of a fake army grows linearly while its influence stays frozen at zero until the thaw.
